# App Modernization target architecture

Use only when the activation context grants this exact capability and stage.

1. Verify the assessment and risk/compatibility predecessor digests.
2. Define principles, component responsibilities, interfaces, decisions, and non-goals.
3. Keep the proposal repository-only, behavior-preserving, incremental, and reversible through reviewed Git history.
4. Leave migration planning and every human gate to their deterministic owners.

Never choose a repository, path, route, transition, credential, tool, retry, effect, deployment, or publication target.
